# GAM - Automatic Permissions generated by GeneXus

When [GAM is activated](https://wiki.genexus.com/commwiki/wiki?19946) in a [Knowledge Base](https://wiki.genexus.com/commwiki/wiki?1836), pressing F5 causes the generation of Automatic Permissions.

Then, permissions are checked every time the applications are run.

To provide Automatic Permissions in your KB you have to set the [Enable Integrated Security property](https://wiki.genexus.com/commwiki/wiki?14706) to "True" and the [Integrated Security Level property](https://wiki.genexus.com/commwiki/wiki?15214) to "Authorization".

### [Automatic Permissions](#Automatic+Permissions)

To understand how Automatic Permissions work, read [Permission Prefix property](https://wiki.genexus.com/commwiki/wiki?17571).

When each permission is generated, it is registered as an Application permission so it will be available [to be assigned to any Role](https://wiki.genexus.com/commwiki/wiki?17963).

### [Where do you see the generated permissions?](#Where+do+you+see+the+generated+permissions%3F)

From the [GAM Web Backoffice](https://wiki.genexus.com/commwiki/wiki?15935) you can see the generated permissions of an application by selecting "Applications" and choosing the desired application.
